# WinFulltime

> Data-driven football predictions, in-play alerts and expert analysis for smart bettors. Free daily picks across 1X2, Over/Under (including Under 2.5), BTTS, Corners, Cards, and streak markets, built from statistical models and head-to-head analysis.

## Core Pages

- [Home](https://winfulltime.com/): Today's free football predictions across all markets.
- [Best Picks](https://winfulltime.com/best-picks.html): The single highest-confidence pick per category for today.
- [H2H Picks](https://winfulltime.com/author-picks.html): Curated daily picks, one best market per fixture based on head-to-head analysis.
- [2 Odds of the Day](https://winfulltime.com/2-odds-of-the-day.html): Two low-odds selections for today, chosen for safety.
- [In-Play Predictions](https://winfulltime.com/predictions/in-play): Live in-play predictions and alerts.
- [Match Analysis](https://winfulltime.com/analysis.html): Full statistical analysis for today's matches.
- [AI SportyBet Code Builder](https://winfulltime.com/ticket-builder.html): Build and optimize accumulator tickets from today's picks.
- [AI Booking Code Converter](https://winfulltime.com/converter.html): Decode and convert booking codes between SportyBet, MSport, Bet9ja, and Betway.
- [Blog](https://winfulltime.com/blog/): Betting guides, strategies, and bookmaker reviews.
- [About](https://winfulltime.com/about.html): Who we are and how WinFulltime predictions work.
- [Contact](https://winfulltime.com/contact.html): Contact the WinFulltime team.

- [Under 2.5 Predictions](https://winfulltime.com/predictions/under-2-5): Matches tipped for fewer than 2.5 total goals.
- [BTTS Yes Predictions](https://winfulltime.com/predictions/btts): Both teams to score predictions.
- [BTTS No Predictions](https://winfulltime.com/predictions/btts-no): Both teams to score NO predictions.

- [Corners Predictions](https://winfulltime.com/predictions/corners): Corner count predictions.
- [Cards Predictions](https://winfulltime.com/predictions/cards): Cards market predictions.

## AI Code Builders

- [AI SportyBet Code Builder](https://winfulltime.com/ticket-builder.html): Generate free SportyBet booking codes in Nigeria from football and basketball picks, including moneyline and points Over/Under selections.
- [AI betPawa Code Builder](https://winfulltime.com/betpawa-builder.html): Generate free betPawa accumulator codes in Nigeria from today’s 1X2 picks, unbeaten records and head-to-head analysis.
- [AI 1xBet Code Builder](https://winfulltime.com/1xbet-builder.html): Generate free 1xBet accumulator codes in Nigeria from today’s 1X2 picks, unbeaten records and head-to-head analysis.
- [AI Booking Code Converter](https://winfulltime.com/converter.html): Decode, preview and convert betting codes between SportyBet, Bet9ja, MSport, Betway, BetKing and Bangbet.
- [AI Code Merger](https://winfulltime.com/code-merger.html): Combine multiple betting codes into one SportyBet code and fold repeated selections together.
- [AI Code Splitter](https://winfulltime.com/code-splitter.html): Split one long betting code into several smaller SportyBet codes.
- [AI Code Analyzer](https://winfulltime.com/code-analyzer.html): Score every leg of a SportyBet code for risk and rebuild the code with risky selections removed.
